name: Goldenshore
description: A sunlike star warming a dune world and a living shore with a single bright moon. Gold light sets over breaking surf every evening on schedule. The shore's phosphorescence draws visitors from three sectors.

stars.name: Goldenshore Light
stars.description: A calm yellow dwarf with a warm golden cast the settlers never stop praising. Its cycle runs quiet decades at a time. Sunsets here are a scheduled attraction.

planets.name: Dunegold
planets.description: A dune sea glittering with mica that catches the gold light at dusk. Caravans cross between oasis towns on fixed seasonal routes. The sand itself is assayed, sold, and sung about.

planets.name: Shorebreak
planets.description: A shallow-sea world where every breaker glows faintly with living light. A single bright moon pulls postcard tides. Beach leases fund the whole system's schools.

moons.name: Postcard
moons.description: A photogenic cratered moon hanging over every postcard view of the shore. Tide stations on its surface keep the beach clocks. Its phases set the festival calendar.
